subject: Visibility add-ons: retention, tracing & dashboard packaging
messages:
From: James Lee <james.lee@dataforge.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 09:14:23 -0700
Subject: Visibility add-ons — retention and tracing pricing

Hi Priya,

Thanks for the demo yesterday — the latency profiles looked promising. We're evaluating Redwood for model serving and have a couple of visibility-related questions that will determine procurement path: 

1) Can you provide a pricing breakdown for the observability add-ons we discussed: long-term trace retention (90d / 365d) and the advanced dashboard pack (custom dashboards, alerting, per-route traces)? We expect ~10M tokens/day steady state but peak bursts are possible.
2) Do you offer credits or tiered discounts if we commit to a 12-month Dedicated + add-on commit? Any interplay between reserved capacity credits and add-on fees?

Also: sizing guidance would help — approximate storage and ingest cost for tracing (we plan to keep spans at 1:100 sample rate with full payload for errors).

If you can attach a one-pager or sample quote we can share with procurement, that would speed things up.

Thanks,
James
James Lee
Head of Platform Engineering | DataForge

Subject: Re: Visibility add-ons — retention and tracing pricing

Hi James — great to meet you yesterday.

Appreciate the clear asks. High level answers below; I attached a compact pricing sheet with scenarios (visibility-addon-pricing-sheet-v2.pdf). I'll loop in Ben (pricing) and Sergio (SE) for technical sizing.

- 90-day retention: fixed monthly add-on $3,500 + $0.02/GB ingested (approx for traces + spans); estimated incremental storage for your 10M tokens/day = ~1.2TB/month (see sheet).
- 365-day retention: fixed monthly add-on $9,000 + $0.015/GB ingested; storage delta is the main driver.
- Advanced dashboards: $2,000/month for up to 25 custom dashboards, includes alerting and saved views; additional dashboards $60/dashboard/month.

Commit/discounts: for a 12-month Dedicated commitment we can offer a 12% credit that can be applied to add-on fees (not to marketplace third-party fees). Alternatively, if you want to lock a combined commit for Dedicated + visibility add-ons we can structure a blended discount — Ben will propose a numeric offer.

Sergio — can you confirm storage/ingest assumptions for James' workload (sample rate, error retention)?

Next steps: I'll send a short SOW and a redline-friendly quote. If procurement needs an authoritative SKUs list we can provide that.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Visibility add-ons — pricing scenarios and commit credit proposal

James — following on Priya's note, adding a concise pricing scenario with committed discount mechanics. See the attached sheet for the math, summary below:

Scenario A — 12-mo Dedicated commit (baseline) + 90d retention + dashboards- Dedicated commit: $120k/mo (example capacity for 10M tokens/day)- Visibility add-ons (90d): $3,500/mo fixed + est $5,000/mo ingest/storage- Dashboards: $2,000/mo- Commit credit: 12% of committed Dedicated spend applied monthly (credit can be allocated to add-ons up to 50% of the credit)

Scenario B — 12-mo Dedicated commit + 365d retention- Dedicated commit: $120k/mo- Visibility add-ons (365d): $9,000/mo fixed + est $18,000/mo ingest/storage- Dashboards: $2,000/mo- Commit credit: 12% with option to front-load credits in Q1 for a 2% additional discount

Notes: credits are contractual; if you prefer an all-in blended price we can convert to a single monthly charge and bake the commit discount into add-ons. If procurement wants firm caps on ingestion spikes we can include throttling/alerting and surge billing rules in the SOW.

I've included an 'economics by month' tab in the PDF that shows token-to-GB mapping we used. Happy to hop on a quick call to walk the numbers.

Cheers,

Hi Priya — procurement follow-up items for the legal/Security review: 

1) Does the visibility add-on data (traces, spans, payloads) reside in Redwood-managed storage or is it isolated per-customer in our VPC? We need to confirm data residency and encryption-at-rest controls.
2) For 365-day retention, what is the RTO for retrieval and are there any cold-storage tiering costs?
3) Any standard clauses around deletion upon contract termination (notifications, timeline)?

We also request a redlined SOW draft and a sample invoice that shows how credits apply to add-ons vs Dedicated capacity.

Sr. Procurement Manager | DataForge
procurements@dataforge.com
From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Elaine Wu <elaine.wu@dataforge.com>, James Lee <james.lee@dataforge.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 08:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Visibility add-ons — procurement questions & next steps

Elaine / team — thanks for the detailed list. Sergio answered the technical pieces offline and I've summarized below so procurement has a single source-of-truth. Attached: SOW_Draft-DataForge.docx and visibility-addon-pricing-sheet-v2.pdf.

- Data residency: For Dedicated and Private deployments we support customer-managed VPC storage; for Hosted customers visibility artifacts are stored in Redwood-managed storage with AES-256 encryption-at-rest. We can include a clause to specify region (US) for your account.
- Retrieval / tiering: 365-day retention is online by default. We do offer an optional lifecycle policy to move >180-day cold objects to an infrequent-access tier; that reduces storage costs by ~30% and adds a small per-retrieval fee (outlined in the pricing sheet). RTO for cold-tier retrieval is typically <24 hours.
- Deletion on termination: standard 30-day retention-to-delete window post-termination, with immediate deletion available on request (with an audit log delivered). We'll include a contract clause for a documented deletion schedule.
- Credits & invoicing: Credits from Dedicated commit are contract-line items. Per our proposal you can allocate up to 50% of the monthly credit to add-ons; remaining credit applies to Dedicated charges. We'll provide a sample invoice showing the allocation.

Lauren has approved the commercial concession in-principle (Ben: 12% credit + option of front-loading in Q1 for an extra 2% as discussed). If DataForge agrees, we'll generate a redline-friendly SOW and the invoice sample for procurement review.

Next steps:
- Priya to share SOW_Draft-DataForge.docx and pricing sheet (attached).
- DataForge to confirm whether you'd like the 12% credit or the front-loaded option.
- If acceptable, legal/procurement to return a redline and we'll aim to finalize within 10 business days.

Thanks all — happy to jump on a short call if that helps expedite.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
priya_natarajan@redwood.com
